create_text_to_speech: create a text-to-speech audio file from text using the configured TTS provider
check_tts_requirements: check if at least one TTS provider is available and properly configured
stream_tts_to_speaker: stream TTS audio to a speaker in real-time by consuming text deltas from a queue
strip_markdown_for_tts: strip markdown formatting from text so it reads cleanly when spoken aloud
convert_to_opus: convert an MP3 audio file to OGG Opus format for Telegram voice bubble compatibility
